findings.issue: Noise schedule lacks precise mathematical definition. Design.md provides cosine_beta_schedule() function but marks it PROVISIONAL. CURRENT_STATE.md mentions linear β: 1e-4 → 2e-2 which contradicts design.md. User must choose and approve specific schedule with mathematical formula.

50-step sampling method not precisely specified. Design.md states 'PROVISIONAL: Uniform stride (every 20th step)' without user approval. Requirements.md lists three options (uniform, quadratic, DDIM) but no choice made. User must approve specific timestep selection method.

Architecture memory validation not performed. U-Net configuration (128 base channels) requires memory validation on T4 GPU before approval. Design.md provides rough estimate (~2-4 GB) but states validation required. Need detailed calculation, conservative reduction to 64 channels, or fallback clause.

Testing specification file missing. Multiple documents reference .kiro/specs/03-latent-diffusion/testing.md but file does not exist. Testing requirements scattered across requirements.md Section 16 and design.md Section 9. Must create testing.md or update all references.

VQ interface shape requires empirical verification. Specification documents latent shape as (B, 4, 60, 80) based on config parameter latent_channels=4, but actual encoder may produce different channel count. Must load checkpoint and verify z_quantized.shape empirically.

Checkpoint path inconsistency. Requirements/design show 'best_model (1).pth' (with space) but audit shows 'best_model(1).pth' (no space). Must verify actual filename and correct all specifications. Consider renaming to avoid parentheses.

Per-channel statistics usage not clarified. Design.md documents both global and per-channel statistics but only uses global for scaling. Defers per-channel to ablation but doesn't explicitly state this is reference-only documentation. Add clarifying note.
EMA usage not explicitly stated in sampling pseudocode. Sampling algorithm in Section 11.3 should explicitly show ema.apply_shadow(unet) before sampling and optional restore after.
Computational cost breakdown missing. Evaluation.md estimates 2-5 seconds per image but lacks breakdown of U-Net forward pass time, number of steps, and decode time. Would help set expectations.

Boundary proxy disclaimer could be strengthened. Add prominent banner at start of Section 5.5 stating proxy limitation immediately visible to readers: '⚠️ PROXY LIMITATION: All boundary metrics use gradient-based proxy, NOT ground-truth mixed-pixel annotations.'
